items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Well, Bud Russel took me in the band with them.

ctx.x: Well, he had a little kazoo made in the form of a cornet. Yeah, yeah. And you could be two blocks away at night and hear that boy blowing that thing and you'd swear that somebody would a trumpet. Yeah, yeah. Well, we formed that little combo and there was nobody to touch us at that time. Well, all during the meantime I was getting my beats together, you understand what I mean? Because a lot of the boys was out on drums, they wasn't getting their beats together, nothing like that. They were just playing mostly for…
Who else was in the band, you remember?
